title: RouterOS /app YAML
description: MikroTik RouterOS /app container application definition (7.22+). Editor-friendly variant: relaxed port validation (no regex), case-insensitive env var names. Use routeros-app-yaml-schema.latest.json for strict CI validation.
$comment: SchemaStore submission target. Differences from .latest.json: (1) ports items have no pattern (see per-item $comment for strict regex); (2) environment patternProperties allows lowercase names.

descr.description: Human-readable description shown in the app UI

page.description: Project page URL, shown as the /app's `project-page` property

category.description: App store category. Validated against RouterOS-accepted values; build CI raises an issue when new categories appear.

icon.description: Icon image URL, displayed on the WebFig landing page when `/app/settings show-in-webfig=yes` (the default).

default-credentials.description: Login credentials shown in the app UI, informative only. Format: `username:password`; may contain placeholders such as `[secret:name]`. May be left blank or `null`.

url-path.description: Path appended to the /app URL, e.g. `/login` or `/web`

credentials.description: Credential hint displayed in the app UI (alternative to default-credentials)

auto-update.description: When `true`, the /app is updated automatically when a new container image is available

supported-archs.description: CPU architectures supported by the /app. Devices not matching the specified architecture do not display the /app (RouterOS 7.25+).

compatible-boards.description: Board names supported by the /app, e.g. `RDS2216`; the `*` wildcard is accepted. Devices not matching the specified board name do not display the /app.

secrets.description: Secret declarations, referenced with `[secret:name]` placeholders and by service `secrets`. RouterOS generates the values when the /app runs; entries are normally empty/null.

services.description: Container services. At least one entry required.

image.description: Container image reference. Omit registry to use `registry-url` from `/container/config`.

container_name.description: Container name shown in the `/container` menu; also used as the base for file paths

entrypoint.description: Executable used as the container entry point, overriding the image default (string or list)

command.description: Startup command executed inside the container, overriding the image default (string or list)

oneOf.description: Two formats supported: (1) `[ip:]host:container[/tcp|/udp][:label]` (OCI-style, pre-7.23) or (2) `[ip:]host:container[:label][:tcp|:udp]` (RouterOS 7.23+, protocol after label). RouterOS placeholders `[accessIP]`, `[accessPort]`, `[accessPort2]`, `[containerIP]`, `[routerIP]` expand at deploy time. The `:label` suffix (e.g. `web`) is RouterOS-specific — `web` marks this port for browser forwarding and appears in the admin URL shown in Winbox/WebFig.
oneOf.$comment: Two strict patterns used in .latest.json (anyOf): (1) old OCI-style: ^(ip:)?host:container(/tcp|/udp)?(:label)?$ and (2) new RouterOS 7.23+ style: ^(ip:)?host:container(:label)?(:tcp|:udp)?$ where label may not contain / or :. Mixing both protocol styles in one entry is rejected.
Long syntax port mapping with named fields

oneOf.description: Map of env var name → value. Keys: letters, digits, underscore (case-sensitive).

environment.description: Service environment variables (object, KEY=value array, or null)

configs.description: Config file mounts. Each `source` must match a top-level `configs` key.

depends_on.description: Names of services that must start before this service

devices.description: Hardware devices passed through to the container, e.g. `/dev/ttyACM0:/dev/ttyACM0`

user.description: Linux user or UID the container runs as (name or `uid:gid`)

stop_grace_period.description: Timeout for graceful shutdown, e.g. `30s` or `0` (default 30 seconds)

build.description: Build configuration for a locally built image

healthcheck.description: Health check run when the container starts; `test` runs inside the container and passes on exit code 0

stdin_open.description: Keep stdin open even if not attached

expose.description: Ports exposed to other containers without publishing them on the router

secrets.description: Secret names available to this service, mounted as files at `/run/secrets/<name>`

secret.description: Singular secret alias accepted by RouterOS built-in app YAML

attach.description: Whether to attach to the container's stdio

volumes.description: Named volume definitions. Referenced by service `volumes` entries.

networks.description: Network declarations. Define `default` as an external network (e.g. `lan`) to place the /app directly on it instead of behind NAT.

external.description: Reference a pre-existing network rather than creating one

configs.description: Config file content definitions. Each key is referenced by a service's `configs[].source`.

content.description: Inline file content injected into the container at deploy time
